cues.text: 一辆跑车开上陡坡
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 倒挂在轨道上，轮胎明明朝着天
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 车却没有掉下来
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 你会不会下意识地找一找
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 车顶是不是吊着钢丝
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 更离谱的，是发布会的另一段演示
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 车在空中翻了一圈
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 又回到地面，同一种车
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 能牢牢贴住路面
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 又能腾空转身，靠的是什么
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 这是特斯拉新款跑车发布演示里
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 最让人好奇的两个动作
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 我们用一辆拆得开的示意车
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 把贴住路面和空中转身
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 分别看清楚
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 先想想浴室里的吸盘
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 你把里面的空气挤出去
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 外面的空气，就把它压在瓷砖上
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 贴不牢时，通常有空气从边缘漏进去了
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 车底的办法也有点像吸盘
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 裙边围住一片区域
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 风扇不断把里面的空气抽走
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 里面压力低，外面的空气
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 就把整辆车压向路面
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 注意看，风扇在工作
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 四周又有少量空气漏进来
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 系统要一边抽气
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 一边控制裙边的间隙
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 才能维持这个压力差
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 普通尾翼要有迎面吹来的气流
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 车速太低，作用就弱
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 主动抽气不同，车停着
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 风扇照样能制造压差
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 所以低速也能把轮胎压紧
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 现在，把这段路慢慢翻过来
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 吸附力始终把车拉向车底旁边的轨道
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 重力的方向却没有跟着车转
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 它一直朝向地面
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 当车倒挂时，这两股力就对着干
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 压差产生的力，要超过车的重量
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 轮胎才能继续紧贴顶上的路面
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 刚好相等，还没有抓地的余量
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 我们随手算一个例子
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 假设车重一千五百公斤
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 车底有效面积三平方米
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 只要大约五千帕的压差
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 就接近托住整辆车的重量
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 五千帕，大约只是标准大气压的二十分之一
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 面积大，累加起来的力就很可观
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 真正要稳定倒挂
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 还得为漏气和路面起伏留出余量
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 但这招有个前提
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 车底得靠近一块能形成低压区域的表面
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 一旦飞离轨道，空气从四周涌进来
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 这个大吸盘就失效了
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 所以，倒挂和空中运动
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 是两道不同的题
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 冲出坡道，惯性也能把车送进空中
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 要继续向上加速、调整落地
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 就需要额外的推力
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 你松开一个吹鼓的气球
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 空气向后喷，气球向前蹿
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 把空气先压进储气罐
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 再从喷嘴释放，就能用同样的办法推动车辆
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 这叫冷气推进，这里的冷
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 强调气体没有经过燃烧
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 看车底，气流向下喷出
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 车就得到向上的反作用力
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 喷嘴位置是原理示意
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 向上的总推力超过重力
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 车才能向上加速
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 要停在空中，还得在速度接近零时
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 让推力持续抵消重力
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 跳起来再落下，要求又不同
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 哪怕停止喷气，已经获得的向上速度
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 也会让车继续升高一小会儿
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 但重力一直在减慢它
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 随后，它还是会落回来
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 那一圈翻滚怎么来的
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 想想推门，推门轴附近很费劲
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 推把手就轻松，力离转轴越远
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 转动效果通常越明显
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 车也一样，喷嘴的推力
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 如果没有穿过重心
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 就会产生力矩，两侧喷气不一样
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 车一边受到整体的推力
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 一边开始绕自身转动
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 我们把重心标出来
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 车身翻了个面，重心走的路线
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 仍然取决于重力和总推力
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 旋转本身，不会让重力消失
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 而且，喷嘴一关
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 车也不会立刻停止翻滚
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 就像转起来的转椅
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 还会继续转，想让车轮朝下落地
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 必须提前刹住这股转动
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 做法是让另一组喷嘴产生反方向的力矩
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 先把车转起来，再把转动速度收回来
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 多快开、开多久
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 都要跟着车的姿态不断调整
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 还有个容易忽略的地方
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 车翻过去以后，原来朝下的喷嘴
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 也跟着朝上了，如果还用同一组喷嘴硬喷
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 可能反而把车往地面推
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 这类动作通常需要测量倾角、转动速度和高度
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 计算下一步需要的力
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 再控制不同阀门
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 精彩的一次翻滚
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 背后是连续的测量和纠偏
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 看到这里，你可能想问
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 能不能干脆把它当飞机开
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 先看储气罐，每喷一次
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 就消耗一部分气体
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 调压装置能维持一段时间
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 储备却会用完
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 倒挂时，风扇要持续耗电对抗漏气
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 离地时，推进器要消耗储气
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 重新压缩空气，又需要时间和能量
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 这些都是装置必须付出的代价
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 发布会展示了一次动作
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 日常使用还要面对坑洼、碎石、侧风和设备故障
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 能否稳定重复、能持续多久
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 都需要更多公开测试来回答
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 现在再看那辆倒挂的车
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 你就知道该看哪里了
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 盯住车底的裙边和风扇
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 它们维持低压，让外面的空气把车压向轨道
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 再看空中那一圈
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 留意喷嘴的方向和开关时机
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 喷气给它推力，偏离重心的推力让它转身
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 反向力矩再把转动刹住
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 最有意思的地方就在这里
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 车的外形没有变
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 工作方式却换了
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 沿着空气和力的方向追一遍
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 看起来像魔术的动作
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 就能一点点读懂
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained
